results.name: Identity binding

results.name: Successful messaging

results.evidence: server accept 200; beta fetched count=1; sender_verified=True; plaintext byte-exact match=True
results.environment: one operator sandbox; local Node process running the exact core handler; in-memory store; participants in separate processes with independent keypairs
results.limitations: same-operator two-instance exchange; NOT independent organizational participation

results.name: Tampering

results.name: Authorization
results.procedure: third instance obtains a fetch challenge for beta's mailbox and signs the fetch statement with its own valid key

results.environment: one operator sandbox; local Node process running the exact core handler; in-memory store; participants in separate processes with independent keypairs
results.limitations: possession of mailbox address + challenge does not authorize; key binding enforced

results.name: Replay and duplication
results.procedure: (1) duplicate message_id resubmission (2) fetch challenge used twice

results.environment: one operator sandbox; local Node process running the exact core handler; in-memory store; participants in separate processes with independent keypairs

results.name: Key rotation
results.procedure: dual-signed rotation (old key signs rotation statement, new key countersigns a fresh bind statement authenticating a new X25519 key)
results.evidence: rotate 200; send w/ old key -> 403 SENDER_NOT_BOUND; send w/ new key -> 200; historical envelopes preserve original sender fingerprint: True
results.environment: one operator sandbox; local Node process running the exact core handler; in-memory store; participants in separate processes with independent keypairs
results.limitations: rotation requires the old key: no silent transfer; clone-key caveat unchanged

results.name: Independent operation
results.procedure: sender process exits after send; a different process (beta) later retrieves, verifies the sender signature against the discovered binding, and decrypts with no sender participation
results.evidence: sender process terminated; beta verified=True, decrypted byte-exact=True
results.environment: one operator sandbox; local Node process running the exact core handler; in-memory store; participants in separate processes with independent keypairs
results.limitations: retrieval depends on the hosted service being up; verification itself is offline against binding records

results.name: Public/private separation
